# Lung’Ie dictionary

**Language:** Lung’Ie / Principense  
**ISO 639-3:** pre  
**Translation pairs:** Lung’Ie → Portuguese; Lung’Ie → English
**Project started:** 23 March 2023  

This file is a **Lung’Ie-only** linguistic dataset. It is not a website and not an application.
Forro and Angolar words do not belong in these entries.

Entries are isolated Lung’Ie forms from named sources (Rougé & Schang 2012, APiCS Principense / Maurer 2013, Araujo 2013, Agostinho & Araujo 2021, Bandeira 2017 Lung’Ie column only, and Bandeira & Araujo 2022 Lung’Ie cells only). Forro and Angolar files in this repository are not evidence for Lung’Ie.

If a requested Lung’Ie term is not in this dataset:

```json
{"status": "error", "code": "TERM_NOT_FOUND", "message": "Translation not available in the verified Lung’Ie database."}
```

Machine-readable copy: `dictionary.json`. Source record: `sources.md`.
Parent index: `../dictionary.md`.

Spoken APiCS examples are stored in `Audio/` and linked on matching entries.

---

## lung’Ie

**Language:** Lung’Ie  
**Part of speech:** noun

### Portuguese
Língua da ilha do Príncipe. Ie é a designação nativa de Príncipe.

### English
The language of the island. Ie is the native name of Príncipe.

### Sources
- APiCS Principense survey (Maurer 2013).

**Verification:** VERIFIED

**Confidence:** high


## kume

**Language:** Lung’Ie  
**Part of speech:** verb

### Portuguese
Comer.

### English
Eat.

### Example
Ine sa kume.

**PT:** Eles estão a comer.
**EN:** They are eating.

## ka

**Language:** Lung’Ie  
**Part of speech:** particle

### Portuguese
Habitual, estado atual, futuro. Allomorfo a.

### English
Habitual, current state, and future. Allomorph a.

### Example
Amanhan n ka kume ki Zwan.

**PT:** Amanhã eu comerei com o Zwan.
**EN:** Tomorrow I will eat with Zwan.

**Language:** Lung’Ie

## fa

**Language:** Lung’Ie  
**Part of speech:** negation

### Portuguese
Negador de SV em posição final. na só em orações pa (finais / desiderativas). Não há na … fa como no Forro.

### English
Verb-phrase-final negator. na only in purposive/desiderative pa-clauses. No Santome-style na … fa.

### Example
Ê vê Pedu fa.

**PT:** Ele não viu o Pedu.
**EN:** He didn’t see Pedu.

### Sources
- APiCS Principense 37-100. Maurer 2009: 133. Also: Amanhan n sa kume ki Zwan fa.

**Verification:** VERIFIED

**Confidence:** high


## ki

**Language:** Lung’Ie  
**Part of speech:** relative

### Portuguese
Relativo.

### English
Relative.

### Example
Omi xila, ki sa dôtô, ê vika fa.

**PT:** Aquele homem, que é médico, não veio.
**EN:** That man, who is a doctor, did not come. (APiCS: Omi xila, ki sa dôtô, ê vika fa.)

### Sources
- APiCS Principense survey example (22). Rougé and Schang 2012: 83 ki in lung'ie.

**Verification:** VERIFIED

**Confidence:** high
